bluetooth_confirm.description:
Do you want to set up {name}?

After setup, on the first poll press the power button on the scooter once when asked, to confirm pairing.

⚠️ Only the Ninebot MAX G30/G30D is confirmed working. Support for other models (Max G3, G2, F2, E-series …) is under active development and will probably not work yet — reports and diagnostics are welcome.

abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured Ninebot scooters found nearby. Wake the scooter and make sure it is within Bluetooth range.

data_description.poll_interval: How often to connect and read the scooter while it is awake. Lower is more responsive but uses more Bluetooth airtime and battery.
data_description.v2_password: Only needed for newer models that are already linked to the official Segway-Ninebot app and therefore refuse a new pairing. 32 hex characters. Leave empty otherwise.
